definitions.analysis_window: client: scheduled_ms >= 8000 (warm-up 8000 ms excluded; equals in_analysis_window flag, verified); origin: arrival_ms_since_load_start >= 8000
definitions.denominators: success rate = status 200 / scheduled requests in window (no-response counts as failure; 503 counts as failure); shed fraction = 503 with X-Cache-Error CapacityExceeded / scheduled in window
definitions.percentiles: nearest-rank = sorted[ceil(p*n)-1]; interpolated = linear (R type 7). Latency column = latency_ms (done - scheduled, coordinated-omission-safe); alternates: service_latency_ms (done - send), and 200-only subsets. All window rows (incl. fast 503 sheds) are included in the primary latency numbers.
definitions.aggregations: pooled = concatenate all 10 runs of the arm then percentile; mean_of_per_run = arithmetic mean of 10 per-run percentiles; difference_of_pooled = pooled(treat) - pooled(BASE)
definitions.paired: unit = repetition (n=10). diff = treat - BASE per rep. CI = percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples, mulberry32 seed 20261030) of the mean diff; t-CI df=9; exact two-sided sign-flip permutation over 2^10 sign patterns on the mean. Relative reduction per rep = (BASE - treat)/BASE; reported as mean of per-rep values with percentile-bootstrap CI.
definitions.why_not_per_request: Requests within a run share cache state, origin queue, gateway state, timer/CPU contention and a common Poisson/Zipf realisation (and the same seed in all 3 arms of a rep), so they are autocorrelated and not independent; a per-request interval (n~69,000) would claim precision the 10 independent replicates do not have. Only repetitions are exchangeable.
definitions.recovery: artifact doc: seconds after degraded end until every later 1 s bin (error = status != 200 or no response, by scheduled_ms) / gateway in_flight snapshot is back at the healthy-phase level. Healthy level for errors: pooled error rate in the healthy phase (alt: max healthy 1 s bin); for in_flight: max snapshot in the healthy phase (alt: mean). Snapshot clock assumed = load start (offset0) and also with an estimated offset.
definitions.verdict_rule: Spec section 7: mechanism pass (max origin concurrency <= cap in every capped run); benefit supported iff paired relative peak reduction >= 5% with CI excluding zero AND origin p99 not worse (mean paired diff <= 0) AND client success not more than 1 pp below BASE; trade-off failure if benefit on load but success < -1 pp; inconclusive if <10 valid runs, contention (send-lag p99 > 100 ms from the runbook) or CI includes zero with upper bound >= 5%.

STATIC-CAP.why: benefit on origin load but success rate -4.947 pp vs BASE (limit -1 pp)

AIMD-CAP.why: benefit on origin load but success rate -17.118 pp vs BASE (limit -1 pp)
